name: receiptdrop
description: Manage ReceiptDrop receipts and Footprints, cross-check trips, and generate reimbursement packages from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Upload, find, view, and manage receipts.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to your ReceiptDrop account to query, create, update, and soft-delete synced Footprints; upload and search receipts; cross-check business trips; and generate reimbursement packages.
defaultPrompt: Upload these receipt files to ReceiptDrop.
Show my ReceiptDrop receipts uploaded today.
Check my ReceiptDrop account and remaining receipt quota.
Find my ReceiptDrop receipts from this month.
Find my meal and transport receipts from a business trip this month.
Show where I ate in July using my Footprints.
Record a Footprint after showing me the details for confirmation.
Cross-check my business-trip receipts against my Footprints.
List my recent receipts so I can choose which ones to reimburse.
